manuscripts.script_description: Fully vocalised naskh in black ink, red rubrics (headwords / abbreviation marks), ruled gold-and-black frame; page 1 has an illuminated headpiece band "باب الهمزة فصل الألف". Clean, regular hand - the "easy" copy.
manuscripts.licence: Public domain (manuscript and faithful scans; U-M states it does not hold copyright in the manuscripts and asks for attribution). Scans distributed via HathiTrust (watermark "Digitized by / Original from University of Michigan" visible in the margins).
manuscripts.licence_note: U-M Islamic Manuscripts guide (Citation & Permissions): "The University of Michigan does not hold the copyright for the manuscripts and so cannot grant or deny permission"; attribution requested and the curator (Evyn Kropf) asks to be notified of reproductions. HathiTrust per-volume rights code not checked (site unreachable) - verify it reads "pd".
manuscripts.credit_line: Isl. Ms. 22, University of Michigan Library (Special Collections Research Center), Ann Arbor. Digitized by the University of Michigan Library (via HathiTrust). Layout + transcription: OpenITI arabic_ms_data.
